typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		DATACENTER_NAME as string,
		DATACENTER_POWER as string,
		DATACENTER_POWER_CONSUMPTION as string,
		TODSH_BUSINESS_EFFECTIVE_DATE as timestamp,
		RACK_WF_GUID as string,
		DATACENTER_WF_GUID as string,
		COMPUTER_ROOM_GUID as string,
		ZONE_WF_GUID as string,
		RACK_POWER_CONSUMPTION as string,
		RACK_MANUFACTURER as string,
		RACK_NAME as string,
		RACK_LOCATION as string,
		RACK_UNITS as string,
		RACK_UNITS_IN_USE as string,
		ZONE_FLOOR_SPACE_IN_USE as string,
		ZONE_FLOOR_SPACE as string,
		ZONE_POWER_CONSUMPTION as string,
		ZONE_NAME as string,
		ROOM_FLOOR_SPACE_IN_USE as string,
		ROOM_FLOOR_SPACE as string,
		COMPUTER_ROOM_POWER as string,
		COMPUTER_ROOM_POWER_CONSUMPTION as string,
		COMPUTER_ROOM_NAME as string,
		DESCRIPTION as string,
		DATA_CENTER_OPERATIONAL_STATUS as string,
		DATACENTER_OWNED_BY_GROUP_GUID as string,
		DATACENTER_OWNED_BY_GROUP as string,
		DATACENTER_SUPPORT_GROUP_GUID as string,
		DATACENTER_SUPPORT_GROUP as string,
		LOCATION_GUID as string,
		MANAGED_BY_GROUP_GUID as string,
		MANAGED_BY_GROUP_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(ImportDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		MANAGED_BY_GROUP_GUID as string,
		COMPUTER_ROOM_NAME as string,
		RACK_NAME as string,
		MANAGED_BY_GROUP_NAME as string,
		DATACENTER_OWNED_BY_GROUP as string,
		RACK_POWER_CONSUMPTION as string,
		RACK_WF_GUID as string,
		ZONE_FLOOR_SPACE_IN_USE as string,
		RACK_MANUFACTURER as string,
		COMPUTER_ROOM_POWER_CONSUMPTION as string,
		DATA_CENTER_OPERATIONAL_STATUS as string,
		COMPUTER_ROOM_GUID as string,
		ZONE_WF_GUID as string,
		RACK_UNITS as string,
		RACK_LOCATION as string,
		ZONE_FLOOR_SPACE as string,
		DESCRIPTION as string,
		ROOM_FLOOR_SPACE as string,
		DATACENTER_SUPPORT_GROUP_GUID as string,
		ROOM_FLOOR_SPACE_IN_USE as string,
		DATACENTER_SUPPORT_GROUP as string,
		ImportDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		DATACENTER_NAME as string,
		RACK_UNITS_IN_USE as string,
		DATACENTER_WF_GUID as string,
		COMPUTER_ROOM_POWER as string,
		ZONE_NAME as string,
		DATACENTER_POWER as string,
		DATACENTER_POWER_CONSUMPTION as string,
		DATACENTER_OWNED_BY_GROUP_GUID as string,
		LOCATION_GUID as string,
		TODSH_BUSINESS_EFFECTIVE_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ZONE_POWER_CONSUMPTION as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		MANAGED_BY_GROUP_GUID,
		COMPUTER_ROOM_NAME,
		RACK_NAME,
		MANAGED_BY_GROUP_NAME,
		DATACENTER_OWNED_BY_GROUP,
		RACK_POWER_CONSUMPTION,
		RACK_WF_GUID,
		ZONE_FLOOR_SPACE_IN_USE,
		RACK_MANUFACTURER,
		COMPUTER_ROOM_POWER_CONSUMPTION,
		DATA_CENTER_OPERATIONAL_STATUS,
		COMPUTER_ROOM_GUID,
		ZONE_WF_GUID,
		RACK_UNITS,
		RACK_LOCATION,
		ZONE_FLOOR_SPACE,
		DESCRIPTION,
		ROOM_FLOOR_SPACE,
		DATACENTER_SUPPORT_GROUP_GUID,
		ROOM_FLOOR_SPACE_IN_USE,
		DATACENTER_SUPPORT_GROUP,
		ImportDate,
		DATACENTER_NAME,
		RACK_UNITS_IN_USE,
		DATACENTER_WF_GUID,
		COMPUTER_ROOM_POWER,
		ZONE_NAME,
		DATACENTER_POWER,
		DATACENTER_POWER_CONSUMPTION,
		DATACENTER_OWNED_BY_GROUP_GUID,
		LOCATION_GUID,
		TODSH_BUSINESS_EFFECTIVE_DATE,
		ZONE_POWER_CONSUMPTION),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
